name: Boat Wreckage
summary: Off the coast, Boat Wreckage holds a clue for Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold. A well-cared-for knife lies in the mud, and you sense something else in the water.

sections.title: A Knife in the Mud
sections.body: Near the wrecked boat, you feel through the mud and find a well-cared-for knife. Whoever was aboard may have lost it when the large chunk went missing from the boat. You take the knife to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold. Ginro asked you to bring back any clue you found, yet something else still shares the water.

sections.title: A Question for You
sections.body: Ginro believes the knife belonged to Raschal and asks if you found it on the bottom beside his boat. The knife alone may not link the boat to Raschal's disappearance. Ginro has another way to learn more: psychometry. Have you heard of it?

aliases: where do i find the knife
faq.answer: The knife lies in the mud beside the wrecked row boat, in the water off the coast.

faq.q: Who wants the clue brought back?
faq.answer: Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold asked you to bring back any clue you found.

faq.q: What sort of knife is it?
faq.answer: The knife is well cared for and lies in the mud beside the wrecked boat. Whoever was aboard may have lost it.

faq.q: What comes directly before investigating the wreckage?
faq.answer: It follows the second part of The Missing Courier, when you were asked to find the courier's boat.
